TCP State Machine & Handshake Transitions

Computer Networking & Finite State Automata

1. Protocol State Transitions

A TCP connection lifecycle progresses through explicit discrete finite state machine states: CLOSED -> LISTEN -> SYN_SENT -> SYN_RECEIVED -> ESTABLISHED -> FIN_WAIT_1 -> FIN_WAIT_2 -> TIME_WAIT -> CLOSED. During the three-way handshake:

  • CLOSED: Initial dormant state
  • SYN_SENT: Client sends SYN packet, awaiting ACK
  • ESTABLISHED: Connection open, bidirectional byte streaming active
  • TIME_WAIT: 2MSL timer running before full socket release

An unexpected RST packet triggers immediate abortive transition to CLOSED regardless of current state.
